headline: NVIDIA CEO targeted by Chinese spies
standfirst: New reports suggest Jensen Huang was under surveillance by the Chinese government.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Reports indicate that Chinese government spies targeted NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Multiple sources claim the surveillance operation was identified during the Trump presidency.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: NVIDIA is a critical player in global chip technology. Protecting its leadership is vital.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: President Trump reportedly chose not to act. We are watching for further official responses.

caption:
New reports reveal NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese government spy operation.

Sources including The Guardian and Engadget suggest that this surveillance occurred while Donald Trump was in office. It is reported that the administration decided against taking action at the time. This highlights the ongoing geopolitical tension surrounding major tech companies.
